snippet.title: Infinite Ruins - Official Gameplay Trailer [ Indie-Credible Showcase 2026 ] [4K]
snippet.description:
An incremental mining game where you manage golems, destroy blocks, unlock upgrades, and descend infinitely in search of ever more valuable resources. The goal is not just to progress, but to optimize: decide which upgrades to buy, when to automate, which abilities to activate, and how to scale efficiently. If you enjoy games where numbers grow, decisions matter, and every unlock feels meaningful, you’ll find a long-lasting experience here.

Official Steampage:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4317900/Infinite_Ruins/

This trailer is part of the Indie-Credible - Indie Game Showcase 2026:
